title: Memory safety bugs fixed in Firefox ESR 140.10, Thunderbird ESR 140.10, Firefox 150 and Thunderbird 150
description: Memory safety bugs have been fixed in Firefox ESR 140.10, Thunderbird ESR 140.10, Firefox 150, and Thunderbird 150. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-6786 and is associated with Microsoft. The advisory references the Microsoft Support Lifecycle for software support details. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
